question: What recitation must be performed after taking up the matter at that time?
premises: An action of taking has occurred at that time.
The root mantra is designated for recitation.
The prescribed count is one hundred and eight.
inference: After taking it up then, one must recite the root mantra one hundred and eight times.
uncertainties: The object implied by gṛhītvā is not explicitly stated in this verse.
plain_english: Having taken it then, one should recite the root mantra one hundred and eight times.
